svg.title: Autocomplete latency by query class
svg.desc: p1: sift 0.27, sift (positions off) 0.27, pg_search 0.72, pg_textsearch 775, rum 24.98, pgx-bm25 6.89, Elasticsearch 0.59; p2: ; p3: sift 0.28, sift (positions off) 0.25, pg_search 0.86, pg_textsearch 8.39, rum 3.01, pgx-bm25 30.69, Elasticsearch 0.76; p4: ; w1: sift 0.26, sift (positions off) 0.20, pg_search 1.08, pg_textsearch 4.76, rum 0.43, pgx-bm25 1.99, Elasticsearch 0.44; a2: sift 0.25, sift (positions off) 0.25, pg_search 1.23, pg_textsearch 4.37, rum 5.98, pgx-bm25 5.44, Elasticsearch 0.64; a2s: ; a3: sift 0.30, sift (positions off) 0.28, pg_search 1.86, pg_textsearch 4.17, rum 6.84, pgx-bm25 8.85, Elasticsearch 0.70; x2: sift 0.28, sift (positions off) 0.26, pg_search 1.49, pg_textsearch 4.09, rum 4.72, pgx-bm25 5.24, Elasticsearch 0.81
svg.text: p50 milliseconds, logarithmic axis, lower is better
Error bars: one standard error over the interleaved rounds (rough for 2-3); red: relative error above 10%.
NA: no bar, the engine cannot run the workload or was not run on the dataset.
Elasticsearch: a JVM server over HTTP, edge n-grams of the typed words expanded by the client.
pg_textsearch: emulation (edge n-gram text, it has no native prefix scoring), see docs/BENCHMARKS.md.
p1-p4: 1-4 letter prefix; w1: whole word; a2, a2s: word + 2 or 1 letter prefix; a3, x2: 3 or 2 prefixes
GeoNames cities15000, 34,166 places, top-20, 1 client, median of 2 rounds; CPUs: 7 lanes of 1 + 1 CPUs (load avg 10-11); Oct 2026.
